IB A3 Databases | Higher Level

HL SQL Worksheets

This pack is Higher Level only. The Standard Level SQL work stays in SL Unit 6. Here the focus is the HL extension: COUNT, AVG, SUM, MAX, MIN, GROUP BY, and HAVING. One worksheet uses a ready-made dataset; the second is an optional build-and-report synthesis task.

A3.3.4 only Grouped reporting Optional build challenge
Open HL Dataset Back to Unit 5

HL Focus

  • A3.3.4 COUNT, AVG, SUM, MAX, MIN, GROUP BY, and HAVING
  • Grouped calculations for reporting and decision-making
  • No SL retrieval reteaching on this page

Suggested Use

  • Run the aggregate worksheet first with the prepared HL dataset.
  • Use the build-and-report worksheet only if you want a synthesis task that combines SL structure work with HL reporting.
  • Students should already know the SL SQL before starting this page.

Worksheet 1 | HL Focus

Course Enrolment Reporting

Use a ready-made HL dataset to practise grouped counts, averages, totals, highest and lowest values, and grouped filtering with HAVING.
